Calculate variant and create modified country_list_object

Source: R/Variants.R
variants_loader.Rd

Applies per-country variant settings (e.g. fertility convergence, migration adjustments) from info_variants to the country objects stored inside a projection object. Must be called after create_projection_object and before project. Calling it a second time on the same object is blocked unless force = TRUE.

Usage

variants_loader(
  projection_object,
  country_info = base_data_list[[10]],
  force = FALSE
)

Arguments

projection_object

Projection_object; an unresolved projection object whose country objects will be modified by variant settings

country_info

Data frame; variant settings for each country, typically `base_data_list$info_variants` (default `base_data_list[[10]]`)

force

Logical, if TRUE loads a variant even if a variant has been already loaded. (default FALSE)

Value

The input projection_object with modified country_object_list.

See also

info_variants for a description of the variant settings table, create_projection_object to create the object passed here, project to run the projection after loading a variant. vignette("conducting-projections") for a full walkthrough.

Examples

p_object <- create_projection_object(name = "test")
#> [1] "Global starting parameters:"
#> [1] "Migration: TRUE"
#> [1] "Light migration: TRUE"
#> [1] "Switching: TRUE"
#> [1] "Light switching: TRUE"
#> [1] "Switching type: split"
#> [1] "Steps: 11"
#> [1] "No fertility differentials: FALSE"
#> [1] "Post switch separation: FALSE"
p_object <- variants_loader(projection_object = p_object)
#> [1] "Variant successfully loaded."
